method: Library samples time 1,000 constructions in each of nine retained samples per process, for three process pairs. Probes count 12,000 builds including warmups and include timer overhead. CLI times include startup and serialization. In reverse runs the candidate driver is passed first.

names.patch:
diff --git a/planning.mbt b/planning.mbt
index c0db350..8277356 100644
--- a/planning.mbt
+++ b/planning.mbt
@@ -154,8 +154,8 @@ pub fn planning_problem(
     }
     rules.push({
       id: "dependency" + i.to_string(),
-      from: point(a, d.kind == "FS" || d.kind == "FF"),
-      to: point(b, d.kind == "FF" || d.kind == "SF"),
+      from: names[2 * a + (if d.kind == "FS" || d.kind == "FF" { 2 } else { 1 })],
+      to: names[2 * b + (if d.kind == "FF" || d.kind == "SF" { 2 } else { 1 })],
       lower: Some(d.min_lag),
       upper: d.max_lag,
     })

roles.patch:
diff --git a/planning.mbt b/planning.mbt
index c0db350..1793a1e 100644
--- a/planning.mbt
+++ b/planning.mbt
@@ -142,9 +142,16 @@ pub fn planning_problem(
     let d = dependencies[i]
     let a = task_index(tasks, ids, d.before)
     let b = task_index(tasks, ids, d.after)
-    if !["FS", "SS", "FF", "SF"].contains(d.kind) ||
-      d.min_lag < -1000000 ||
-      d.min_lag > 1000000 {
+    let offsets = match d.kind {
+      "FS" => Some((2, 1))
+      "SS" => Some((1, 1))
+      "FF" => Some((2, 2))
+      "SF" => Some((1, 2))
+      _ => None
+    }
+    guard offsets is Some((from_offset, to_offset)) &&
+      d.min_lag >= -1000000 &&
+      d.min_lag <= 1000000 else {
       raise StnError(
         "invalid_input", "dependency kind must be FS/SS/FF/SF and lag within +/-1000000",
       )
@@ -154,8 +161,8 @@ pub fn planning_problem(
     }
     rules.push({
       id: "dependency" + i.to_string(),
-      from: point(a, d.kind == "FS" || d.kind == "FF"),
-      to: point(b, d.kind == "FF" || d.kind == "SF"),
+      from: names[2 * a + from_offset],
+      to: names[2 * b + to_offset],
       lower: Some(d.min_lag),
       upper: d.max_lag,
     })
